note: The parts of a resume this repository cannot measure: education, employment, class work and named tools. Everything else on resume.html is generated from the same measurements the rest of the site is built from, and none of it is typed here. A section with no entries is not rendered at all, and the build prints which ones are empty on every run. Every numeral in this file is declared here rather than computed, and check 13 holds the page's numerals to this file for exactly the entries below.

shape.education: institution, credential, from, to, note, awards, coursework (a label to a list), activities.
shape.experience: employer, place, title, from, to, lines. Each line is one thing done and what came of it.
shape.projects: title, when, note, lines. Class work and competitions, kept apart from paid work.
shape.skills: group, items. A group is a heading, items a list of names. No levels: the site does not rate itself.
shape.service: group, items. The same shape, kept out of skills because volunteering is not a competency.
